d.a: Distribution and ecology. The plant was found growing on a damp rock-wall along a stream with mosses, pteridophytes (Selaginella sp., Asplenium sp.) and Begonia spp. (Begoniaceae). The plant was collected from Lungleng village in Aizawl District of Mizoram, India which is located at 23 ° 39 ' 57 " N, 92 ° 39 ' 41 " E, south of Aizawl city. Positioned at an elevation of 1011 m above sea level, Lungleng receives an average annual rainfall of about 2500 mm, with temperature ranging from 26 ° C – 31 ° C. The settlement lies atop a hill and is encircled by a narrow belt of dense community reserve forest comprising subtropical broad-leaved evergreen mixed forest and with patches of secondary forest surrounding the reserved area.
